title: Arbitration and Conciliation Act s. 58 — Statutory provision (ACA s. 58)

content.overview: Section 58 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter II, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.
content.glance: Section 58 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter II, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.
content.study:
Section 58 — Enforcement of foreign awards

Section 58 provides that where the Court is satisfied that a foreign award is enforceable under Chapter II, the award is deemed to be a decree of that Court.

Apply the provision within Chapter II of Part II and identify the precise Convention framework, statutory condition and enforcement consequence. Do not treat enforcement as a merits appeal.
